verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only the Thoropass MCP server, which lets external AI assistants act inside a Thoropass workspace. That is the server role and does not transfer to this client-side story. Nothing shows Thoropass's own AI features, such as the AI Helpbot or First Pass AI, connecting to user-supplied MCP servers to use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
